name: How long does interior painting typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does interior painting typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an interior painting project depends on several factors, including the size of the area, the condition of the surfaces, and the complexity of the job. A single room might take 1-2 days, while an entire house can range from 3-7 days. During our consultation, we will provide a detailed timeline based on your specific project, minimizing disruption to your daily routine.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies based on size and complexity; a single room may take 1-2 days, an entire house 3-7 days.
